observation: Dry green-bordered basins sit between pale stacks and the long tan roof.
Low green pools and outer blue channel remain visible around the roof.
Left raised source pool overlooks dry front ring basins and tan platforms.
Blue right pool connects to the arched white route beneath the rear fountain.
Tall rear cascade stands behind pale blocks and a dry front courtyard.
Blue elevated route runs into the foreground basin within the planted stone frame.
Left green arches surround dry square pools and a tan central pillar.
Green rear pool and blue front basins remain separated by the crossing bridge.
Rear ring basin and two tall arches rise above dry central blocks.
Green rear pool and broad white bridge connect to the right blue basin.
Two rear sources sit behind dry white channels and a green front feature.
Raised white aqueduct crosses the green courtyard beside the blue lower pool.
Broad tan roof shelters green center water and dry side channels.
Upper blue pool and green center feature remain visible around the encircling route.
Twin rear arches face four dry garden basins among pale block stacks.
Winding green channel passes alongside the upper blue pool and front courtyards.
A green-framed dry basin sits inside the elevated masonry on the right.
Raised white loop surrounds the blue center basin without clipping the planted frame.
Staggered rear source and green arch rise above dry ring basins.
Green upper basin and blue lower pools connect at clearly distinct heights.
Dense pale blocks and hanging front vines surround the dry center basin.
Long high white aqueduct spans the central green route and small blue pools.
Dry front ring basin and rear garden roof sit above pale channel stacks.
Blue foreground basin and raised rear water remain completely in the camera frame.
